source_summary: Tall hanging-scroll landscape with misty mountains, pines, bamboo, water, bridge, small boat, rocks, and an open pavilion containing seated scholars. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from the motif bank.

motifs.name: upper_right_cliff_spires
motifs.description: Isolate the high craggy mountain formation at the upper right, including the central vertical cliff, the narrow distant spire behind it, the overhanging right ledge, and the small pine clusters and shrubs rooted along the rock shelves.
must_preserve: vertical ink-wash cliff faces fading into mist
angular rock ledges and broken contour lines
dark pine silhouettes along the cliff tops
small dotted shrub textures on ledges
soft mist edges at the cliff bases

motifs.name: arching_pine_canopy
motifs.description: Isolate the large old pine sweeping across the middle of the painting, with its twisting trunk and branches extending from the right side toward the left, carrying dense rounded clusters of pine needles.
must_preserve: rounded needle clusters made of fine radiating strokes
irregular trunk knots and bark texture
subtle green-gray wash within the pine masses

motifs.name: waterside_pavilion_scholars
motifs.description: Isolate the open pavilion built over water, including its tiled roofs, railings, lattice screens, supporting posts, interior furniture, and the seated scholar figures gathered around the table.
must_preserve: precise roof geometry with layered eaves
open lattice screens and carved rail patterns
thin vertical support posts over the water

motifs.name: right_bamboo_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the dense bamboo grove rising beside and behind the pavilion on the right, including slender stems, leaf sprays, and overlapping clusters around the pine trunk.
must_preserve: pointed leaf clusters in dark ink
subtle wash separation between bamboo layers

motifs.name: left_stream_bridge_boat
motifs.description: Isolate the left-side water scene with the pale stream surface, small arched bridge, rocks, bank vegetation, and the tiny moored boat near the shrub-covered bank.
motifs.role: water, bridge, and small boat setting
must_preserve: soft bank washes and shrub dots

motifs.name: foreground_right_rocks_tree_base
motifs.description: Isolate the rugged foreground rocks and base of the large tree on the lower right, including the sloping boulders, exposed roots, grasses, and small bamboo or shrub tufts around the base.
must_preserve: small grass clumps at the water edge
low shrub and bamboo leaf accents

motifs.name: foreground_left_blossom_branch
motifs.description: Isolate the low foreground branch entering from the lower left, with its twisting dark limb, thin offshoots, and sparse small blossoms or buds above the water and grasses.
must_preserve: nearby grass strokes at the base

motifs.name: open_mist_water_bird
motifs.description: Isolate the quiet open mist and water passage in the upper-left to middle-left area, including the tiny flying bird and the faint horizontal atmospheric washes, while excluding seals and inscriptions.
motifs.role: misty negative space and distant water atmosphere
must_preserve: tiny bird silhouette with spread wings
subtle atmospheric void around the bird
faint tonal transitions without paper texture

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
